label: Plastic bottle
keywords: plastic bottle;water bottle;fanta;coke bottle;7up;lucozade;shampoo bottle;milk bottle
tip: Drinks bottle with the Re-turn logo? Bring it back to a Re-turn machine for your deposit.

label: Drinks can
tip: Drinks can with the Re-turn logo? Bring it back to a Re-turn machine for your deposit.

label: Food tin
keywords: tin;bean tin;soup tin;tuna tin;pet food tin

label: Plastic tub or pot
tip: Rinse it first. A dirty pot can spoil the whole recycling bin.

label: Soft plastic
keywords: plastic bag;bread bag;wrapper;cling film;plastic film;bubble wrap
tip: Clean and dry soft plastics can go in the recycling bin.

label: Paper
tip: Keep it clean and dry. Food-soiled paper can go in the food bin. Shiny till receipts (thermal paper) go in general waste.

label: Cardboard
tip: Flatten boxes. Tear off the greasy part of a pizza box for the food bin and recycle the clean part.

label: Aluminium foil or tray
tip: Scrunch clean foil into a ball.

label: Glass bottle
tip: Rinse it and take off the lid. Glass never goes in your recycling bin.

label: Glass jar
tip: Rinse it. The metal lid can go in recycling.

label: Food waste
tip: No plastic bags in the food bin. Use compostable bags or paper.

label: Takeaway coffee cup
tip: Most takeaway cups have a plastic lining. The clean lid and cardboard sleeve can go in recycling.

label: Polystyrene
tip: Polystyrene cannot be recycled at home.

label: Battery
tip: Never put batteries in any bin. Most shops that sell them take them back for free.

label: Small electrical item
tip: Bring to a shop or civic amenity site that takes electrical waste (WEEE).
